name: legitimate-thread-reply
description: The false positive the thread rules must not produce. An ordinary working conversation in which the cast changes for entirely normal reasons: a colleague at the sender's own company answers from a different mailbox, an external consultant is looped in from a domain nobody in the thread has used before, and a participant replies from the company's country domain rather than its .com. All three are new senders relative to the thread, so a rule that fired on unfamiliarity would fire three times here. None of them resembles an established domain, which is the distinction the rules are built on. Also carries routine payment wording, so it doubles as a check that thread context does not amplify the content heuristics.

email.subject: Re: PO 4471 - remittance for September deliveries
email.bodyText:
Hi Alex,

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
